newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin sees HSBC news in March.
newsitem.headline: Serfin sees HSBC news in March.

text.p: A long expected deal between Grupo Financiero Serfin SA de CV and HSBC Holdings Plc could finally be sealed this month, a spokesman for the financial group told Reuters on Tuesday.
"There will be news this month of negotiations underway with the Hongkong Shanghai Bank," Serfin press officer Roberto Aguirre said, confirming earlier newspaper reports.
The deal could entail HSBC Holdings buying a 19.9-percent stake in Serfin. Aguirre said details of the sale would not be known until a group board meeting is held.
He added that a meeting had been planned for March 14.
"The sale cannot be finalized if there has not been a prior board meeting," Aguirre said.
The sale of 19.9 percent of Serfin's shareholding equity would come as part of the group's commitment to Mexican financial authorities to raise $1.24 billion in capital.
